brief.name: PennyPlan
brief.category: Personal finance: budgeting app (fictional demo product)
brief.pitch: PennyPlan helps young couples split each paycheck into named jars and see what they can still spend today, with manual entry and shared jars.
mechanics: Split each paycheck into named jars
See how much is left to spend today
Enter transactions and jar amounts manually
Share jars between two people in a couple
No bank account linking in v1
brief.art_style: Calm fintech with flat illustrations of jars
facts: Users split each paycheck into named jars.
The app shows what is left to spend today.
Data can be exported as CSV.
Version 1 does not link to bank accounts.
not_true: PennyPlan does not give investment advice.
PennyPlan does not offer credit products.
PennyPlan does not link to bank accounts in v1.
PennyPlan does not offer real-money rewards.
PennyPlan does not move or hold real money.
